title: No signs of AI payoff outside the tech sector
why_read: A substantive, data-grounded discussion of whether AI investment is translating into measurable economic productivity gains, relevant to engineers weighing hype against evidence.
analysis: This piece reportedly argues that outside of the tech industry itself, there is little measurable economic payoff yet from AI adoption, based on productivity or output data. For engineers, this matters because it cuts against the narrative that AI is already transforming every industry's bottom line. The heavy comment engagement suggests a contentious topic with many anecdotal counterpoints, which is itself informative about how practitioners perceive AI's real-world impact. Worth reading for a reality check against pure hype cycles.
